messages:
Anya: Quick heads-up — StitchCloud confirmed the integration launch window next Wed (May 10). Want to sync on: launch post, benchmark narrative (latency vs. cloud vendor), webinar slot, and how inbound leads route. TL;DR: partner wants a co-hosted webinar + a dual blog + marketplace listing push.
Marc: Nice. Do we have a benchmark owner? I can get infra numbers but need product quotes for user impact.
Taylor: I can own the blog + messaging. Can we align on two narratives: (1) speed & cost with Redwood serving runtime, (2) simplicity of marketplace install?
Anya: Perfect. Marc — can you run a light perf matrix across 8k seq / 2x GPU vs 16k seq? We want head-to-head numbers for the blog and a 1-slide summary for the webinar.
Marc: Yep, will run today. Estimated finish by EOD tomorrow. Will post raw numbers in the doc.
Sam: For webinar — prefer Thurs 5/11 10am PT or Wed 5/10 11am PT? StitchCloud favors the latter. Are we OK with Wed 11am PT?
Taylor: Wed 11am PT works. That gives us 1 full week for dry runs.
Anya: OK Wed 11am PT booked. Can someone create a shared slide deck and attach the benchmark slide early so partners can review?
Taylor: I'll start a deck — adding outline: intro (5m), demo (10m), benchmark + cost talk (7m), customer Q&A (20m).
Sam: For inbound lead routing: proposal — any signups go to Stitch SDRs + ours. Rule: enterprise-qualified -> direct to AE (redwood-sales@), all others -> Stitch nurture. Thoughts?
Marc: Sounds good. Need mapping table for Lead Source -> Owner. Also need to confirm whether marketplace leads include customer contact info; Stitch marketplace gives hashed email only.
Anya: Good catch. If hashed email only, we should route marketplace leads into a nurture sequence and ADS (Stitch) will do the follow-up. For webinar landing signup, capture email+company — route to Redwood SDR first, then share with Stitch within 24h.
Taylor: I'll add routing rules to the doc. Also messaging iteration: propose two hero taglines for A/B test on landing + blog: 
- "Ship LLM features with predictable inference economics"
- "Scale low-latency LLMs across cloud marketplaces"
Which do we prefer for the webinar registration?
Sam: Prefer the first for product-first audience. Second works for marketplace listing.
Anya: OK we'll A/B test hero on the reg page (50/50). Taylor, put both variants in the doc.
ops-bot: Reminder — create webinar calendar invite and add recording toggle.
Taylor: Done — calendar invite sent to presenters + Stitch hosts. Also added the two hero variants to the registration form draft: https://docs.google.com/rd/launch-stitch-redwood (internal).
Marc: Benchmark update — preliminary numbers: 8k seq on R-3 reduces p99 by ~18% vs baseline; cost per 1M tokens down ~22% with batching and KV cache. I'll paste raw later.
Anya: Awesome. Can someone draft a 300-400 word launch post for cross-post (blog + partner blog)? Keep the benchmark claims tight and link to repo + reproducibility checklist.
Taylor: I'll draft and post a first version by Monday. Will include an explicit "how we measured" appendix.
Sam: Routing config (snippet) I propose we add to ops runbook: ```
if lead.source == "webinar" and lead.signup_type == "company_email":
  assign_to = "redwood-sdr"
elif lead.source == "marketplace":
  assign_to = "stitch-nurture"
else:
  assign_to = "partner-nurture"
```
Anya: That looks good. Two action items for me: confirm marketplace lead payload with Stitch, and finalize PR plan with comms (social + newsletter cadence).
Marc: I'll upload perf logs and a brief methodology section to the doc in ~2h.
Taylor: I'll share draft landing page + A/B config for review by EOD.
Sam: I'll coordinate SDR handoff doc and make sure Stitch has our SLA for lead sharing (24h).
Anya: Great — next sync Friday 9am PT to review slides and landing. Thanks team :rocket:
